first.rationale: Both onboarding completion and activation are down 4-6% QoQ, suggesting friction in early user journey. memory_31 and memory_86 both show that simplification/shortening of onboarding drives measurable lift in activation and completion. This addresses the root cause rather than symptoms. Promotional pricing (memory_73) was explicitly cautioned against due to retention risk and wouldn't be sustainable long-term. Referral incentives (memory_57) work best with established customers, not solving current activation decline. Activation messaging (memory_91) showed promise but is additive; simplifying onboarding tackles the underlying friction. Enterprise sales assist (memory_44) doesn't address SMB segment or the competitor threat. Verifying the two onboarding memories ensures we're replicating conditions correctly before rolling out at standard scale.
